notes: Single-file website for 'Fuego Lento', a fictional Basque live-fire asador in Portland, Oregon. Includes a canvas hearth with wind-reactive flames and a hold-to-stoke interaction that unlocks an off-menu dish; four hand-drawn SVG dish illustrations and an illustrated dining room and map; a 40-dish menu with instant search (with Spanish synonym matching), category and dietary filters; a pickup-order basket with quantities, persistence, hours-aware pickup slots, validation and confirmation codes; a reservation flow with party/date/time logic, deterministic pseudo-random availability, closed Mondays and dated special closures, validation, persistence and two-step cancellation; live open-now status computed from the visitor's clock; opt-in Web Audio hearth crackle; mobile navigation; reduced-motion support. All storage access is guarded. Tested in Chromium via automation: menu, basket, reservation and navigation flows verified, no console errors. Known limitations: availability and codes are deterministic simulations (no backend); the animated fire loop pauses in fully backgrounded tabs by design and repaints on resize.
